observation.visible_scene: Over-the-shoulder view from a moving open vehicle (handlebar with a round side mirror on the left, a drum-magazine machine gun mounted on the right) across a flat salt-playa with tire tracks and low hills under a cloudy sky. A rider in front wears a white mesh trucker cap and earmuff hearing protection, one hand on a grip. In the left-center distance a bright orange ground fire burns continuously throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: The ground fire persists at both ends of the clip (no visible ignition or extinguishing); its rising flame column grows taller and is progressively sheared/tilted leftward by wind, with thin smoke wisps detaching and rising.
The flame's screen position drifts from center-left toward the left frame edge over the sequence, while the burning pool on the ground stays roughly co-located in the world.
The mounted gun and drum magazine shift toward the right edge and partly leave the frame; the rider's head, cap, and hand-on-grip reposition within the frame.
The horizon, hill masses, and foreground ground tracks shift, indicating a change in viewpoint (vehicle/camera turning or translating) rather than the flame itself moving across the ground.
outside_clip_unknowns: What ignited or sustains the fire and the fuel source.
The vehicle's overall route, speed, and purpose, and what lies outside the frame.
Whether the fire continues, spreads, or dies after the last frame.
uncertain_details: Exact direction and magnitude of camera/vehicle motion versus the flame's apparent leftward drift.
Whether apparent changes in flame size reflect distance change, wind deformation, or both.
Precise vehicle type and the relationship between the camera and the rider.
